claim_boundary: Working/lab evidence only; no claim transfers automatically into the active CRPTO IJDS paper.

finding: The active external CRPTO IJDS paper is a retrospective identification audit and selects no learner, residual window, taxonomy, gamma, ruler, coordinate, cap, comparator, or policy.
official_claim: Paper 4 treats current CRPTO as an external identification contract rather than a model or policy winner.
claim_boundary: External context only; local legacy artifacts do not define current CRPTO claims.

finding: The v31 implementation materialized 512 internally generated paths and 494592 policy-month-path rows.
official_claim: The artifact establishes executable paired simulation under one declared internal design.
claim_boundary: Scale and reproducibility fact only; not forecast validity or external robustness.

finding: Conditional on 512 internally generated paths, the preselected CVaR configuration had mean wealth difference -691.34 and exceeded the legacy reference on 244 paths (0.4765625).
official_claim: The internal simulator records a tail-loss/wealth tradeoff for one preselected configuration.
claim_boundary: Conditional descriptive result; no external probability, independent validation, dominance or policy selection.

finding: Among 1010 retrospectively searched online-conformal adjustment rules, 503 met nominal gates on the same replay; the selected rule was then examined in six-month and source-family post-selection slices.
official_claim: The slices document fragility after replay-based selection.
claim_boundary: No strict holdout, refit, prospective validation or live deployment claim.

finding: PyEPO 1.3.7 provides an exploratory top-k teacher-cost benchmark from a frozen calibrated class-1 score model.
official_claim: The retained result is descriptive teacher-regret under randomly sampled and overlapping menus.
claim_boundary: No realized-loss evaluation; no matched model-class attribution; no independent inference; no selected-set coverage or CRPTO policy claim.

finding: DLA/ADP has a formal state/transition framing and failure analysis, but not exact Bellman optimality.
official_claim: Paper 4 can explain dynamic policy behavior using SDAM state variables.
claim_boundary: Representative ADP/rollout evidence; Bellman exact claim is false.

finding: Paper 4 retains the former IFRS9/SICR lane only as a negative readiness-and-estimand audit; it does not identify PD, ECL, SICR or staging.
official_claim: The retained result documents missing report-date units labels and contractual inputs; software sensitivities are mechanical only.
claim_boundary: No PD ECL SICR Stage 2 allowance threshold or monetary inference is permitted.

finding: CATE policy value remains blocked; the high-rate-within-grade result is an observational, noncausal sensitivity.
official_claim: The retained result documents overlap and identification failure rather than a treatment effect.
claim_boundary: No causal effect or CATE policy-value claim.

finding: Fairness remains proxy/source governance only because protected attributes or approved proxy protocol are absent.

finding: Powell/SDAM is useful as a governance and framing contract, not as an automatic optimizer.
official_claim: The paper can separate metrics, decisions, uncertainty, policy class, evidence, and claim scope.

finding: Literature-driven Lab 4 pass closes lanes 1-9 as append, park, diagnostic-negative-audit or context-only evidence.
official_claim: Paper 4 can retain governance, tail and source-governance appendices while keeping IFRS9/SICR as a negative estimand audit and parking E2E, live-online and causal policy-value claims.
claim_boundary: Lab 4 synthesis only; it does not modify the active external CRPTO claim surface.

finding: Archived Paper 2 artifacts are retained only as non-citable provenance and a negative audit of binary-outcome, PD, ECL, SICR, staging and threshold estimands.
official_claim: Paper 4 may document why those substitutions fail; it may not reuse their numerical outputs as evidence.
claim_boundary: No prudential threshold monetary or accounting claim; Paper 2 remains parked pending report-date contractual data and a prespecified final test.

official_claim: The archived comparison reports AUC, Gini/Somers' D, Brier, ECE and decile-band error for the legacy-root model versus the proxy.
claim_boundary: Historical appendix diagnostic only; it is not evidence about the current CRPTO IJDS model or a legal fair-lending analysis.
